_readme: The Game Packs catalog. Each entry's "file" is a RulesForge workbook (.xlsx) — the exact same file the app's own 'Download Excel' button produces. To contribute a real pack: add your own legally-owned rules PDF in the app's Library, use its ⋮ menu → Download Excel, add the file under this folder, and add an entry below. Keep entry ids stable once published — the app uses them to detect updates.

packs.description: An entirely original, placeholder faction used only to prove the download works end to end. Not a real faction — download it to see how a pack lands in your Library.
